title: Iña’s Beachfront Couple's Apartment
description: This newly remodeled unit offers a modern yet tropical space, perfect for couples or friends looking for a different and unique experience in Rincón. You’ll have private and direct access to STEPS Beach which is just a few feet from the door. Located in the heart of Rincón, our property is just a short walk from the marina, the town and some of the finest restaurants in the area. Experience unforgettable views and an exclusive beachfront getaway. By the way…sunset time is the best time☀️🌊The spaceWelcome to Iña’s Beachfront, located at the picturesque Steps Beach in Rincón, PR. Perfect for snorkeling enthusiasts, our property offers direct and private access to the vibrant underwater world of colorful coral reefs and diverse marine life. Enjoy the convenience of nearby restaurants, offering a delightful mix of local and international cuisines. Just a short walk from the Tres Palmas Marine Reserve, our rental provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, ideal for those seeking a memorable beachside getaway. We look forward to welcoming you to your perfect coastal retreat! This is a 2 story house divided in 3 units. Patio/beach area has little lighting.Bedroom is a queen bed.Sofa expands into a queen size mattress.One parking available per unit.In case of power/electricity outage, we do NOT have a power generator.Other things to noteDisclaimer:By booking this property, guests acknowledge and agree that the host is not responsible for any accidents, injuries, or illnesses that occur on the premises or while using the property’s amenities. Guests assume all risks associated with their stay, including but not limited to, swimming, walking on the beach, or using any provided equipment. The host shall not be held liable for any personal or property damage, loss, or theft.There are two cameras at the property, both are on the roof. One has view to the front yard/parking area. The second is located in the adjacent part of the roof with view to the beach entrance. Check out our sister apartment: https://www.airbnb.com/l/fRxLpbqI

description: Welcome to your Puerto Rican beach vacation! This recently remodeled 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom beach house is located directly across the street from Playa Corcega one of Rincon's favorite beaches for swimming, sunbathing, and watching spectacular sunsets with a view of Desecheo Island in the distance.Inside you'll find -AC in every room2 queen bedsBlackout curtains in both bedroomsFull length mirrors1 pull out queen sleeper sofaA smart TVFree WifiA full KitchenThe spaceThe house was recently remodeled in a modern white boho-beach style and features a colorful mural of a sunbathing beach lady - part of the "Beautiful Beach Ladies" series by talented young artists. You'll spot their artwork throughout the park, celebrating women of all ages, backgrounds, and body types in joyful, seaside scenes.Inside the home, you'll find AC and free WiFi in every room, and queen sized beds, blackout curtains and full-length mirrors in both bedrooms and in the living room, a smart TV and a sofa that pulls-out into a queen sized bed. The kitchen is well equipped with full sized appliances; refrigerator, freezer, a range with oven and stove-top, microwave, coffee pot, and a small smoothie blender-perfect for beach day meal prep. Beach towels, bath towels and bed linens are included and the front porch has hammock hooks for island-style relaxing and enjoying your favorite beach read. (BYH, bring your own hammock!)You'll have direct access to one of the last remaining small sandy areas of Corcega Beach - ideal for swimming, lounging, and snorkeling. We offer beach chairs and umbrellas for rent, and ice and propane for sale. Our friendly local staff is always nearby to help with anything you might need.The Rincon Sunset Beach House is part of the Corcega Recreational Beach Property. A vibrant, well-loved beachfront vacation park with a campground-by-the- sea vibe. It includes a beautiful newly remodeled boutique hotel, a large deck event space, five cabins, four eco friendly upcycled shipping container units, and a collection of uniquely designed beach trailers. For over 40 years, this spot has been a favorite weekend getaway for Puerto Rican families.All this and you're just minutes from Rincon's world famous surf breaks, beach bars, amazing local restaurants, coffee shops, and artisan markets every Thursday and Sunday in the town plaza.Whether you're here to surf, snorkel, sunbathe, grill, or soak in the fresh sea air and colorful local flavor- this beachy home puts you right in the heart of it all.Guest access24 hour access by lockbox. Codes sent on the day of check in after your registration is complete.Other things to noteDirections: From Carr. 115/PR-115 turn right on Calle 11. Drive straight towards the ocean. Turn left on Calle 10. The house is the last on your left. The office is a container unit on your right behind our boutique hotel (the big white building on the ocean with brown trim.To receive your personalized access code before arrival, please complete the property agreement and provide the make, model, color and license plate of your vehicle. Once those are in place, you'll receive your code on the day of arrival. Most guest complete this within a few minuets, before their check-in to ensure a smooth arrival.We're ready on our end, just send over the details when you are.As we are located on a tropical island, power outages can occasionally occur. While we do everything we can to ensure a comfortable stay, we are not responsible for area-wide outages that are beyond our control. Thank you for your understanding!
